**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-201451)

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in SMAD4 that lead to a gain-of-function or dominant-negative effect in either disease would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs147887687)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of SMAD4 and TGF-beta signaling in these conditions could inform therapeutic strategies targeting this pathway for both MONDO:0014134 and juvenile polyposis syndrome.
